premise.canon: The gods tried to save tomorrow. The Architect stole it.
opening: Long ago, the world began running out of tomorrows.

Six gods tried to save it, each in their own way. But their miracles clashed, and the world began to break. A mortal known as the Architect built the Great Kilns, sealing the gods away and restoring the passage of time.
Centuries passed. Brass clocks measured the hours, porcelain held them, and lanterns lit the kingdoms. People lived, laughed, and forgot how close the world had come to ending.
Now the porcelain is cracking. Forgotten memories are awakening, and entire villages are losing hours.
You are an independent traveller. Your first duty is simple: mend what is broken.

naming_rule: Title stays Atlas: The Cala Knight. Every new proper name is an Elvish root (Tolkien's Quenya or Sindarin) plus a plain English word, or plain evocative English.
Build names from roots, never from existing Tolkien names (no Gondor, Elrond, Silmaril, Voronwë, Tamar).
At most two names per first letter across races, gods and the Architect. No near-twins such as Nira/Nara.
Names must be easy to say in Thai and English. Avoid th and heavy consonant clusters.
Every key English word (Hearth, Oath, Watch, ...) is used in at most one key name.

wardens.reputation: Reputation comes only from repeatable community-service board quests, never from main-story progress.
wardens.leave_return: resign at the registrar any time; rank and reputation are kept, bonuses pause and resume on rejoining; no fee.
wardens.legend_link: the Wardens keep an incomplete ledger associated with the Last Cala Knight; membership gives no claim to her title.

last_cala_knight.player_facing: the most recent person to hold the title, a woman. No ordinal is ever stated; how many Cala Knights there were is unknown. Her name, race, era and the thing she left unfinished are revealed only through traces (Ch 0-VIII). Expansion I retraces her story.
last_cala_knight.writers_bible: Personality like Himmel (Frieren): kind, cheerful, charmingly vain, chooses people over glory, remembered through small kindnesses. Strength like Serie: the strongest being of her age, far beyond any living warrior, which is why her leaving work unfinished is the central mystery. Benchmark only; borrow no names, lines or designs.
